decisions.statement: Super Admin / Owner global accesses all organizations via tenant selector while maintaining explicit organization_id execution context
Password recovery flow supports graceful fallback when SMTP is unconfigured with Inbucket local support and admin CLI bypass
Enforce atomic purge of caches and mutation queues on logout and tenant switch to guarantee zero cross-tenant leakage

actions: Defined layer map, dependency direction and responsibility matrix
Documented Super Admin / Owner multi-organization access pattern
Documented password recovery flow handling without SMTP server
